title: Routine
description: A reminder the user set for a time of day (AST-5), spoken at that time. Wellness support, not a medical device.

title.description: Short, e.g. Take the evening medicine.

days.description: Days it repeats; empty means every day.

spoken.description: What Cortex says at that time.

next_at.description: The next time it fires; null when inactive.
